units.source_text: 马咯从椅子上站起来，握住我的双手，长叹了一口气说：

en.t: Maro rose from his chair, took both my hands in his, sighed deeply, and said:

units.source_text: “你不是我们河童，自然不理解。

en.t: You are not one of us kappa, so of course you do not understand.

units.source_text: 但是偶尔我也希望那些可怕的雌河童来追我呢。”

en.t: But once in a while, I too wish those frightening female kappa would chase after me.
